best_for: Players of text-based MUDs who want a mapper, Lua scripting and several game connections open at once, on Windows or Mac.

points.title: Lua does the heavy lifting
points.text: Scripts are written in Lua inside a built-in editor, and profiles can be exported and imported to move a setup between machines or share it.

points.title: A mapper that draws as you walk
points.text: The 2D and 3D mapper records rooms as you move and can path-find a route for you. Custom exits and background images let you fix areas the game describes poorly.

points.title: Ready-made game profiles
points.text: Mudlet ships with connection profiles for 46 MUDs, and several game connections can run side by side in one window.

points.title: Free under the GPL
points.text: There is no price and no account. The project is GPL-licensed open source, and the Windows builds are code-signed through SignPath at no cost to the project.

points.title: Accessible to blind players
points.text: The homepage lists accessibility for visually impaired players as a feature, which matters in a genre that screen-reader users still play.

points.title: Windows lags one release here
points.text: mudlet.org offers 5.1.1 as a 64-bit Windows installer, but the Windows listing here is at 5.0.1 and keeps 2 versions. macOS has 5.1.1 in Intel and Apple Silicon builds for macOS 13 or later, and only the current release is listed.

points.title: Linux comes from the project, not this page
points.text: No Linux build is listed here. mudlet.org offers an AppImage and a package repository for Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 and Fedora 43 and 44, and there is also a browser version.
